subject: Quick note on GB Engineering's website
bodyText:
Hi,

I'm Mani from Rogue.

We look for solid businesses that still look stuck online - and GB Engineering stood out.

Maydown stainless and sheet-metal fabricators with 40-plus years behind them - and gb-engineering.co.uk still headlines a NEW Inhouse Lazer Cutting Facility, plus a live Fax on the contact block, on a table-and-font layout that never left the mid-2000s. Real workshop; a shopfront frozen on typos and fax.

If useful, I'll send a short 3-point teardown over email - what's dated, what's costing you, and the first fix. No call required.

Reply YES and I'll send it.
